blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Museum of the Philippines (NMP) highlighted the importance of archaeological impact assessments (AIAs) as it marked International Archaeology Day this month. “Let us understand what AIA is and why it is important before building any structure,” NMP-Cebu said, reminding the public that a specific area might be a potential archaeological site. It said AIAs are important in areas where historical artifacts may lie underground, waiting for their stories to be unraveled, especially since the Philippines is exceptionally rich in archaeological resources.
